description: This Java class 'CollectPartialGrantedSubjectIdsVisitor' is a visitor implementation used to collect subject IDs with certain permissions granted on a resource or its subresources in a permission policy tree. It traverses nodes representing subjects and resources, evaluates permissions, and determines which subjects meet the specified permission criteria.

classes.name: CollectPartialGrantedSubjectIdsVisitor
classes.description: A visitor that traverses a permission policy tree to collect subject IDs with specified permissions granted on a resource or subresource.

classes.name: ResourceNodeEvaluator
classes.description: A helper class within the visitor that evaluates permissions for a specific subject ID in relation to resource nodes.

methods.name: visitTreeNode
methods.description: Visits a node in the policy tree, dispatching based on node type.

methods.name: visitSubjectNode
methods.description: Handles a node representing a subject, creating an evaluator for that subject.

methods.name: visitResourceNode
methods.description: Handles a resource node, aggregating permissions for the current subject.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Returns the set of subject IDs with the expected permissions granted.
